Lemma
[Gram--Schmidt Algorithm for Frames]

1. ch8:8.13If $(X_j)$ is a smooth local frame on an open $U\subseteq \mathbb {R}^n$, then there is a smooth orthonormal frame $(E_j)$ on $U$ such that, for every $p\in U$ and $1\leq j\leq n$, \[ \operatorname {span}(E_1|_p,\ldots ,E_j|_p) =\operatorname {span}(X_1|_p,\ldots ,X_j|_p). \]

Proof

\sketch Apply Gram–Schmidt pointwise:

\[ E_j=\frac{X_j-\sum _{i=1}^{j-1}(X_j\cdot E_i)E_i}{\left|X_j-\sum _{i=1}^{j-1}(X_j\cdot E_i)E_i\right|}. \]

The frame hypothesis makes every denominator nonzero. The formula therefore defines smooth fields and preserves each initial span.
